title: Twyne AAVE operators
protocolOverview: Twyne is a credit delegation protocol that lets borrowers rent unused borrowing power from other lenders to boost their Liquidation LTV. Lenders earn additional yield while borrowers get to ramp up their leverage or insulate their debt.
auditScope: This audit covers 5 smart contracts totaling approximately 541 lines of code across 1 day of review.
overallAssessment: The audit of Twyne's Aave operators identified no critical or high-severity vulnerabilities, indicating a solid implementation that maintains the security standards of the protocol's foundation. The informational and gas findings outlined mostly minor improvements, with the exception of one finding where the Euler controller was not deactivated properly. No funds were at risk from this issue.
treeOfAuditedFiles:
0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/src
└── operators
    ├── LeverageOperator_EulerFL.sol
    ├── DeleverageOperator_EulerFL.sol
    ├── AaveV3LeverageOperator.sol
    ├── AaveV3DeleverageOperator.sol
    └── AaveV3TeleportOperator.sol
finalRemarks: The review focused on new operators for AAVE as well as rework on Euler operators. The AAVE operators will be a welcome addition to Twyne's new AAVE integration, while the Euler operators update will allow the use of Euler directly for flashloans instead of Morpho as in the previous version. The review did not discover any medium severity or above issues, highlighting the seriousness of the Twyne team.

issues.title: Incorrect disable controller call
issues.body:
#### Technical Details

The [leverage and deleverage operators](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/blob/c9164fbb0fda1d9a757e5f790d1aea92eda963b1/src/operators/DeleverageOperator_EulerFL.sol#L125) that use Euler as the flashloan provider first enable the controller via `EVC.enableController()` and then disable it via `EVC.disableController()`, which is incorrect, since the controller must disable itself.

```solidity
120:         eulerFL_items[0] = IEVC.BatchItem({
121:             targetContract: address(EULER_EVC),
122:             onBehalfOfAccount: address(0),
123:             value: 0,
124:             data: abi.encodeCall(IEVC.enableController, (address(this), address(targetVault)))
125:         });
...          ...
147:         // 5) Disable controller
148:         eulerFL_items[4] = IEVC.BatchItem({
149:             targetContract: address(EULER_EVC),
150:             onBehalfOfAccount: address(0),
151:             value: 0,
152:             data: abi.encodeCall(IEVC.disableController, (address(this)))
153:         });
```

#### Impact

Low. The controller is not properly disabled and will remain enabled after the leverage or deleverage call.

#### Recommendation

In `LeverageOperator_EulerFL` and `DeleverageOperator_EulerFL`, change the last element of the Euler batch and call `disableController()` directly through the `targetVault` / `collateralAsset`.

#### Developer Response

Fixed in [PR#204](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/pull/204/files).

issues.title: Potential zero value transfers in `DeleverageOperator_EulerFL`
issues.body:
#### Technical Details

The implementation of [`executeDeleverage()`](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/blob/c9164fbb0fda1d9a757e5f790d1aea92eda963b1/src/operators/DeleverageOperator_EulerFL.sol#L134-L135) returns the leftovers to the caller without checking if the actual amounts are zero.

```solidity
134:         IERC20(targetAsset).safeTransfer(msgSender, IERC20(targetAsset).balanceOf(address(this)));
135:         IERC20(underlyingCollateral).safeTransfer(msgSender, IERC20(underlyingCollateral).balanceOf(address(this)));
```

#### Impact

Gas savings.

#### Recommendation

Check if balances are zero before transferring the assets.

#### Developer Response

Acknowledged.

issues.title: Inaccurate comment in `DeleverageOperator_EulerFL`
issues.body:
#### Technical Details

The following comment in [`onFlashLoan()`](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/blob/c9164fbb0fda1d9a757e5f790d1aea92eda963b1/src/operators/DeleverageOperator_EulerFL.sol#L177) hints that an automatic pull of assets would settle the Euler debt. However, repayment is explicitly performed using `collateralAsset.repay()`.

```solidity
177:         // Collateral asset will automatically pull the repayment amount
```

#### Impact

Informational.

#### Recommendation

Remove the comment.

#### Developer Response

Fixed in [PR#206](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/pull/206).

issues.title: Unbounded debt repayment in AaveV3TeleportOperator
issues.body:
#### Technical Details

The [teleport operation](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/blob/c9164fbb0fda1d9a757e5f790d1aea92eda963b1/src/operators/AaveV3TeleportOperator.sol#L56) takes the `debtAmount` as user input and forwards that amount when repaying the debt using `AAVE_POOL.repay()`. Given that the inner implementation of `repay()` silently limits the repayment amount to the actual debt, using a higher amount would result in a leftover in the operator.

#### Impact

Informational.

#### Recommendation

Cap `debtAmount` to the user's current debt.

#### Developer Response

Fixed in [PR#208](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/pull/208).

issues.title: Morpho references in Euler flashloan operators
issues.body:
#### Technical Details

The `LeverageOperator_EulerFL` and `DeleverageOperator_EulerFL` contracts refer to Morpho when checking the caller in the flashloan callbacks.

- [`LeverageOperator_EulerFL.sol#L169`](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/blob/c9164fbb0fda1d9a757e5f790d1aea92eda963b1/src/operators/LeverageOperator_EulerFL.sol#L169)
- [`DeleverageOperator_EulerFL.sol#L151`](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/blob/c9164fbb0fda1d9a757e5f790d1aea92eda963b1/src/operators/DeleverageOperator_EulerFL.sol#L151)

#### Impact

Informational.

#### Recommendation

Rename the error.

#### Developer Response

Fixed in [PR#207](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/pull/207).

issues.title: Unnecessary 10 wei addition to flashloan amount
issues.body:
#### Technical Details

The [`executeTeleport()`](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/blob/c9164fbb0fda1d9a757e5f790d1aea92eda963b1/src/operators/AaveV3TeleportOperator.sol#L56-L56) function inside `AaveV3TeleportOperator` adds `10 wei` to the Morpho flashloan amount. It's unclear why this value is added, especially if a user already provides the full debt amount or `type(uint256).max`.

Inside `onMorphoFlashLoan()`, `debtAmount` is used for repayment which ignores this 10 wei addition, resulting in useless extra wei being flashloaned.

#### Impact

Informational.

#### Recommendation

Remove the `+ 10` from the call.

#### Developer Response

Fixed in [PR#205](https://github.com/0xTwyne/twyne-contracts/pull/205).
